Map an Indicator with Recorded or User-Supplied Boundaries

Source: R/dsir_map.R
dsir_map.Rd

Draw a choropleth from a dsir_data object, an ordinary data frame or an sf table. Return a standard ggplot. WHO ADM0 boundaries are downloaded by country only with permission and cached outside the package. Alternatively, supply your own polygons for an offline map.

Usage 

dsir_map(
  data,
  value = "value_num",
  country = "iso3",
  year = NULL,
  boundaries = NULL,
  boundary_key = NULL,
  download = c("ask", "allow", "never"),
  cache_dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  crs = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per mapped area. A dsir_data object uses its existing semantic checks. An sf input supplies its own geometry.

value

Name of the numeric value column, default "value_num". For dsir_data, use value_num; for a derived measure, supply an ordinary analysis table with its units defined explicitly instead of borrowing the original indicator's metadata.

country

Name of the area-key column, default "iso3". WHO downloads require uppercase three-letter ISO3 codes. User-supplied boundaries can use other character or factor keys; matching is exact.

year

Optional single integer-valued year, selecting the year column. If that column exists, the selected data must contain one common non-missing year. No latest-year selection or aggregation occurs.

boundaries

Optional sf polygons. If omitted, use geometry in data, or obtain WHO ADM0 polygons. No other source is used to fill gaps.

boundary_key

Key column in boundaries. Defaults to country when present, otherwise "ISO_3_CODE". Each requested key must match exactly one polygon or multipolygon row. Extra, unrequested areas are not drawn.

download

Download policy: "ask" (default) asks interactively when uncached countries are needed; in non-interactive sessions it errors with guidance. "allow" explicitly permits downloads; "never" requires a valid cache or user-supplied geometry. No downloads occur on package load.

cache_dir

Directory for the country cache. Defaults to the maps subdirectory of tools::R_user_dir("DSIR", "cache"). Supply a project directory to retain the exact boundaries used by an analysis.

refresh

Logical, default FALSE. Explicitly download fresh WHO polygons even when cached. Download permission is still required. Failed or invalid downloads never replace a valid country cache.

crs

Optional display coordinate reference system passed to ggplot2::coord_sf(). It does not change cached source geometries.

Value

A ggplot using theme_dsi() and a continuous viridis scale. Missing estimates are shown in grey. Its data is an sf table containing the selected analysis columns and matched geometry. dsir_metadata() reports map-creation context, input metadata and boundary provenance; this record does not audit subsequent ggplot modifications.

Details

The optional package sf is required only when this function is used. Filter to one indicator, measure, unit and population stratum before mapping. Known semantic fields in ordinary tables are checked as well; fields absent from such tables cannot be verified. Ordinary tables should provide a constant unit column when units are known. A matching key alone does not establish geographic or temporal comparability.

Empty or invalid geometries, unknown coordinate systems, missing areas and duplicate keys cause errors. Geometries are never repaired, simplified, dissolved or combined with another source automatically. The WHO ADM0 service returned empty Philippine geometry during development; a Philippine map therefore requires corrected official data or complete user-supplied boundaries. This is validated from each response, not a country blacklist.

Downloads use the public WHO Detailed_Boundary_ADM0 Feature Service, layer 0, item 39663258d2b44dcaa28af952ed40760b, without authentication. Its item terms require use without modification and link to https://data.who.int/about/data/terms-and-conditions. Consult the source terms and appropriate cartographic presentation for your output. Permission to download does not certify geometry completeness.

The downloader verifies one stable feature identifier per country and checks the returned country, coordinate system and geometry before caching. Each cache records its endpoint, query, retrieval time, item modification time, source terms and download checksum. Item modification time is not an official boundary reference date. Cache use preserves retrieval time and makes no network calls. Cached countries may have different retrieval dates; inspect the boundary records when a common snapshot is required.

See also

plot.dsir_data(), dsir_metadata()

Examples 

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Artificial polygons and values for an entirely offline example.
  square <- function(x) sf::st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(x, 0, x + 1, 0, x + 1, 1, x, 1, x, 0), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)))
  borders <- sf::st_sf(code = c("A", "B"),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(square(0), square(1), crs = 4326))
  values <- data.frame(code = c("A", "B"), rate = c(10, 20), unit = "percent")
  p <- dsir_map(values, value = "rate", country = "code", boundaries = borders)
  p
  dsir_metadata(p)$boundaries
}
